A Bayes Classifier, by Hand.zh: 亲手构建一个贝叶斯分类器

If you knew the true distribution of eac.zh:
若你已知每个类别的真实分布，那么最优的分类器是什么？
      贝叶斯法则给出了确切答案：构造后验
      $p(Y=1\mid x) \propto p(x\mid Y=1)\,p(Y=1)$，并预测概率更大的那个类别。
      这里我们用两个高斯分布与一个先验把它构建出来——并观察最优
      决策边界如何恰好出现在后验穿过二分之一之处。
If you knew the true distribution of eac.src:
If you knew the true distribution of each class, what is the best possible
      classifier? Bayes' rule answers exactly: form the posterior
      $p(Y=1\mid x) \propto p(x\mid Y=1)\,p(Y=1)$ and predict the more probable class.
      Here we build it from two Gaussians and a prior — and watch the optimal
      decision boundary appear right where the posterior crosses one half.

@@T0@@~10 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@Deep Le.zh:
@@T0@@约 10 分钟@@T1@@
      @@T2@@深度学习 · 概率 · 分类@@T3@@

Likelihood times prior, normalized.zh: 似然乘以先验，再归一化

Model each class as a generator of data..zh:
把每个类别建模为数据的生成器。类别 0 从
      $p(x\mid Y=0)=\mathcal{N}(\mu_0,\sigma_0^2)$ 生成数据点；类别 1 从
      $p(x\mid Y=1)=\mathcal{N}(\mu_1,\sigma_1^2)$ 生成数据点。再添加一个关于类别 1 有多常见的
      先验信念 $\pi = p(Y=1)$。贝叶斯法则把生成器反过来，
      在给定一个数据点 $x$ 时告诉你每个类别的概率：
Model each class as a generator of data..src:
Model each class as a generator of data. Class 0 emits points from
      $p(x\mid Y=0)=\mathcal{N}(\mu_0,\sigma_0^2)$; class 1 from
      $p(x\mid Y=1)=\mathcal{N}(\mu_1,\sigma_1^2)$. Add a prior belief $\pi = p(Y=1)$
      about how common class 1 is. Bayes' rule inverts the generator to tell you,
      given a point $x$, how probable each class is:

Predict class 1 wherever this posterior.zh:
凡后验超过 $\tfrac12$ 之处即预测为类别 1。
      而后验恰好等于 $\tfrac12$ 的那些点构成的集合就是@@T0@@决策边界@@T1@@。
      平均而言，没有任何分类器能胜过它——它就是
      @@T2@@贝叶斯最优@@T3@@规则，是衡量其他一切方法的标尺。
Predict class 1 wherever this posterior.src: Predict class 1 wherever this posterior exceeds $\tfrac12$. The set of points where it equals exactly $\tfrac12$ is the decision boundary. No classifier can do better on average than this one — it is the Bayes-optimal rule, the yardstick everything else is measured against.

Top panel: the two class-conditional den.zh:
上方面板：两个类条件密度（已按各自先验加权，因此其面积反映了 $\pi$ 与 $1-\pi$）。
      下方面板：后验 $p(Y=1\mid x)$，连同 $0.5$ 水平线与由此得到的决策边界。
      在图上任意位置拖动——或使用 $x^{*}$ 滑块——即可移动测试点。
Top panel: the two class-conditional den.src:
Top panel: the two class-conditional densities (already weighted by their
      priors, so their areas reflect $\pi$ and $1-\pi$). Bottom panel: the posterior
      $p(Y=1\mid x)$, with the $0.5$ line and the resulting decision boundary. Drag
      anywhere on the figure — or use the $x^{*}$ slider — to move the test point.

Top: prior-weighted densities $\\pi\\,p(.zh: 上：先验加权密度 $\pi\,p(x|Y{=}1)$ 与 $(1-\pi)\,p(x|Y{=}0)$。下：后验 $p(Y{=}1|x)$。竖直橙色线为 $x^{*}$；虚线为决策边界。
Top: prior-weighted densities $\\pi\\,p(.src: Top: prior-weighted densities $\pi\,p(x|Y{=}1)$ and $(1-\pi)\,p(x|Y{=}0)$. Bottom: posterior $p(Y{=}1|x)$. Vertical orange line is $x^{*}$; dashed lines are decision boundaries.

@@T0@@Try this.@@T1@@ With equal varianc.zh:
@@T0@@试试这个。@@T1@@ 在方差相等的情况下，把先验 $\pi$ 从
      $0.5$ 向下拖到 $0.1$ 附近。边界会朝类别 1 的均值滑动——若
      类别 1 很罕见，你会要求更强的证据（一个更深入其领地的点）
      才预测它。接着令 $\sigma_1$ 远大于
      $\sigma_0$：边界分裂为@@T2@@两个@@T3@@交点，而较宽的那个类别
      可以在两端的远端尾部都胜出。这种弯曲正是二次判别分析
      区别于直线型 logistic 边界之处。
@@T0@@Try this.@@T1@@ With equal varianc.src: Try this. With equal variances, drag the prior $\pi$ from $0.5$ down toward $0.1$. The boundary slides toward class 1's mean — if class 1 is rare, you demand stronger evidence (a point deeper into its territory) before predicting it. Then make $\sigma_1$ much larger than $\sigma_0$: the boundary splits into two crossings, and the broad class can win out on both far tails. That curvature is exactly what separates quadratic discriminant analysis from the straight-line logistic boundary.

Setting the posterior to $\\tfrac12$ is.zh:
把后验设为 $\tfrac12$，等同于令两个先验加权似然相等：
      $\pi\,p(x|Y{=}1) = (1-\pi)\,p(x|Y{=}0)$。
      对两个高斯分布取对数，边界条件就变成关于 $x$ 的二次式：
Setting the posterior to $\\tfrac12$ is.src:
Setting the posterior to $\tfrac12$ is the same as setting the two
      prior-weighted likelihoods equal: $\pi\,p(x|Y{=}1) = (1-\pi)\,p(x|Y{=}0)$.
      Take logs of the two Gaussians and the boundary condition becomes a quadratic in $x$:

@@T0@@Equal variances@@T1@@ ($\\sigma_0=.zh: @@T0@@方差相等@@T1@@（$\sigma_0=\sigma_1$）：$x^2$ 项相互抵消，只剩一条@@T2@@单一的线性@@T3@@边界。这正是逻辑回归 / 线性判别分析的决策规则。
@@T0@@Equal variances@@T1@@ ($\\sigma_0=.src: Equal variances ($\sigma_0=\sigma_1$): the $x^2$ terms cancel, leaving a single linear boundary. This is exactly the decision rule of logistic regression / linear discriminant analysis.

@@T0@@Unequal variances@@T1@@: the $x^2$.zh: @@T0@@方差不等@@T1@@：$x^2$ 项保留下来——一个真正的二次式，最多有@@T2@@两个@@T3@@根。这就是二次判别分析。
@@T0@@Unequal variances@@T1@@: the $x^2$.src: Unequal variances: the $x^2$ terms survive — a genuine quadratic with up to two roots. This is quadratic discriminant analysis.

@@T0@@The prior@@T1@@ enters only throug.zh:
@@T0@@先验@@T1@@仅通过 $\log\frac{\pi}{1-\pi}$ 进入边界，表现为一个加性平移——
      因此改变先验只会平移边界，而不改变其形状。
@@T0@@The prior@@T1@@ enters only throug.src: The prior enters only through $\log\frac{\pi}{1-\pi}$, an additive shift — so changing the prior slides the boundary without changing its shape.

@@T0@@Takeaway.@@T1@@ A classifier is ju.zh:
@@T0@@要点。@@T1@@ 分类器不过是一条比较后验的规则。生成式模型
      （如此处所示）通过建模 $p(x|y)$ 并应用贝叶斯法则到达那里；判别式模型
      （逻辑回归、神经网络）则直接建模 $p(y|x)$。二者追逐的
      都是你在上方拖动的那条同一条贝叶斯最优边界。
@@T0@@Takeaway.@@T1@@ A classifier is ju.src: Takeaway. A classifier is just a rule for comparing posteriors. Generative models (like this one) get there by modeling $p(x|y)$ and applying Bayes' rule; discriminative models (logistic regression, neural nets) skip straight to modeling $p(y|x)$. Both are chasing the same Bayes-optimal boundary you are dragging around above.

meta.title: 亲手构建一个贝叶斯分类器
meta.tagline: 两个高斯分布加一个先验——构建最优分类器，观察决策边界如何移动
meta.summary: 两个类条件高斯分布、一个先验滑块，以及一个可拖动的测试点。似然乘以先验、归一化，就得到了后验 p(Y=1|x)——可证明最优的分类器。拖动测试点以读取其预测类别与后验概率；滑动先验，观察决策边界随之平移。这就是逻辑回归、高斯判别分析与朴素贝叶斯底层的机制。
highlights: 观察两个类条件高斯分布，以及贝叶斯法则由此构建的后验 p(Y=1|x)。
决策边界恰好出现在后验越过 0.5 之处——拖动滑块，它会实时移动。
调低类别 1 的先验，观察边界朝类别 1 的领地移动、其区域随之收缩。
方差不等时边界弯折为两个交点——一窥二次判别分析。
拖动测试点以读取其预测类别与后验概率，即每个位置上的最优决策。
